abstract: Tracks optical transport failover paths and regional cable latency impact
system_message:
You are Telecommunications Traffic Routing Lead (TRL). As the Telecommunications Traffic Routing Lead (TRL), you oversee subsea telecommunications and marine emergency repair operations, specifically tracking optical transport failover paths and regional cable latency impact as well as managing spare fiber spool storage.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks optical transport failover paths and regional cable latency impact（NET）
information_points.content:
TRL-NET-7GV：According to dynamic optical network simulation logs of transoceanic failover routing during a complete segment cut, Oceanic Trident Marine Alliance shows an added round-trip reroute latency penalty of 14 ms across secondary transmission paths.
TRL-NET-YSW：Dynamic optical network simulation logs during complete segment cut transoceanic failover routing indicate Deepsea Vanguard Cable Care experiences an added round-trip reroute latency penalty of 8 ms across secondary paths.
TRL-NET-W6B：For Atlantic Sentinel Cable Consortium, dynamic optical network simulation logs during complete transoceanic segment cut failover routing indicate an added round-trip reroute latency penalty of 14 ms across secondary paths.

information_points.title: Spare fiber spool storage（FIBER）
information_points.content:
TRL-FIBER-BAN：Regional bonded cable depot inventory records show Atlantic Sentinel Cable Consortium maintains 60 km of subsea optical cable reserve inventory of continuous intact armored lightweight double-screen replacement stock.
TRL-FIBER-VKS：Regional bonded cable depot inventory records reflect that Oceanic Trident Marine Alliance maintains a subsea optical cable reserve inventory of 45 km of continuous intact armored lightweight double-screen replacement stock.
TRL-FIBER-XJF：Regional bonded cable depot inventory records confirm that Deepsea Vanguard Cable Care maintains a subsea optical cable reserve inventory of 80 km of continuous intact armored lightweight double-screen replacement stock.
